summary:
Frontend-only verification of the updated Marketing welcome/idea-assistant page (/marketing/inicio) where ideas now render inside a slide-up Drawer (vaul) with a 'Preparando ideas…' loading state, count reduced to 3, and category labels no longer truncated. All 7 spec items pass.

(1) Login pzsuave007@gmail.com OK → / (after login). Navigated to /marketing/inicio, marketing-start container visible.
(2) Category labels rendered FULL with no 'truncate' class: cat-trabajo_terminado='Trabajo terminado', cat-resena='Reseña de cliente', cat-antes_despues='Antes / Después'.
(3) cat-oferta → ideas-drawer slides up immediately, ideas-loading shows 'Preparando ideas para ti… Dame unos segundos ✨'. Title bar reads 'Preparando ideas…' (per code, while loading).
(4) After ~14s LLM, ideas-list appears INSIDE the same drawer with exactly 3 idea-card-{0,1,2}. Verified outside-of-drawer card count = 0 (no inline rendering). Each card has title, Spanish idea, '📸 Toma esto' photo tip (literal 'Toma esto' present in all 3), and buttons idea-use-post-{i}, idea-use-ai-{i}, idea-use-reel-{i}.
(5) Click idea-use-post-0 → navigated to /marketing?mode=image&brief=<encoded idea>. brief-input pre-filled with the Spanish idea (171 chars, first-30 chars match: 'Publica una oferta por tiempo limitado…').
(6) surprise-btn → drawer opens with loading then 3 mixed ideas; outside-drawer count = 0.
(7) No critical console errors during the run (only the pre-existing Meta pixel traffic-permission warning).

Note: The DrawerTitle reads 'Preparando ideas…' (with ellipsis char) while loading; the loading body uses 'Preparando ideas para ti…' — both contain 'Preparando ideas', matching the spec.
critical_code_review_comments: MarketingStart.js (198 lines) — clean, focused, well within size guideline. Good use of vaul Drawer for the slide-up UX.
(Carryover from iter_27) SocialStudio.js still ~1012 lines; consider extracting PostResultDrawer / CustomizePanel / searchParams brief|imgprompt initial-state reader into smaller modules.
Minor robustness: getIdeas() resets ideas to [] but does not clear activeCat on close; if user re-opens after a previous category, the old highlight may flash. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 7/7 spec items verified (label no-truncate, drawer slide-up, Preparando loading, 3 cards inside drawer, no inline render, idea-use-post prefill, surprise flow).

seed_data_creation: None — ideas generated on-demand by the LLM via /api/social/post-ideas with count=3.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Marketing welcome page now renders ideas inside <Drawer data-testid='ideas-drawer'> (vaul, slide-up). Loading body data-testid='ideas-loading' (text 'Preparando ideas para ti…'), results in data-testid='ideas-list' with exactly 3 cards (idea-card-0..2). Drawer title shows 'Preparando ideas…' while loading and 'Ideas para ti' + category label after. Category buttons no longer have 'truncate' class — labels wrap fully. Selecting idea-use-post-{i} still navigates to /marketing?mode=image&brief=… and SocialStudio reads searchParams.brief into brief-input. count=3 is the new default in MarketingStart.js getIdeas().
rca of the issue: n/a — change verified working as specified.
